title: KAPy derived variables configuration
description: Configuration of derived variables is set through a tab-separated table, with one row per variable. Note that the same schema is used for secondary and tertiary varibles - the main difference is the order in which they processed (primary > secondary > bias-adjustment > tertiary). Note that new variables declared here can refer to other derived variables, as long as they have already been declared higher up in the configuration table. All options are required.

id.description: Code by which to refer to the variable e.g. `tas`, `SPI`, `pr` etc. Cannont contain a space.

enabled.description: Determines whether the row be used in the workflow. A non-empty value indicates not to use that row.

inputVars.description: Comma-separated list of input variables to be used in generating this new variable.

outputVars.description: Comma-separated list of output variables generated by the script. Some functions generate more than one variable at a time e.g. FWI and this is where they should be listed. Currently limited to one but will be extended in the future - issue #92 https://github.com/Klimaatlas/KAPy/issues/92.

passXarrays.description: Should KAPy pass xArray objects to the function? If no, then then path to the input file is passed as a string instead.

scriptPath.description: The path to the python `script` containing the function to be used, relative to the working directory

scriptFunction.description: The name of the functionm contained in `scriptPath` to be used to calculate the new variable

additionalArgs.description: Additional arbitrary arguments specified as a dict to be passed to the function via keyword arguments. e.g. `{'param1':10,'doSim':true,'name':'myname'}`. Can be an empty dict if no there are no additional parameters. e.g. `{}` `
